lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Treasure Hunt. Granny Pig and Grandpa Pig are making a treasure hunt for Peppa and George.
lines.zh: 寻宝游戏。猪奶奶和猪爷爷正在为佩奇和乔治准备一个寻宝游戏。

lines.en: Granny Pig is drawing the treasure map.
lines.zh: 猪奶奶在画藏宝图。

lines.en: Grandpa Pig is burying the treasure in a secret place in the garden. Grandpa Pig, have you finished? Peppa and George will be here soon.
lines.zh: 猪爷爷正在把宝藏埋在花园里一个秘密的地方。猪爷爷，你弄好了吗？佩奇和乔治很快就到了。

lines.en: No need to panic, Granny Pig. Peppa and her family are here! Quick, Grandpa Pig, they're here!
lines.zh: 别慌，猪奶奶。佩奇一家到了！快点，猪爷爷，他们来了！

lines.en: Oh, almost done.
lines.zh: 哦，快好了。

lines.en: Grandpa Pig has just finished in time. Granny Pig, we're here!
lines.zh: 猪爷爷刚好及时完成了。猪奶奶，我们到啦！

lines.en: Hello, my little ones!
lines.zh: 你们好，我的小宝贝们！

lines.en: Peppa, George, we've made you a treasure hunt. Somewhere in the garden is buried treasure.
lines.zh: 佩奇，乔治，我们给你们准备了一个寻宝游戏。花园里的某个地方埋着宝藏。

lines.en: Wow! Treasure! Where is it? You have to look for it.
lines.zh: 哇！宝藏！它在哪儿？你们得自己去找。

lines.en: Here's a treasure map for Peppa and George. Could I wear my pirate hat? Ooh! There, Captain George!
lines.zh: 这是给佩奇和乔治的藏宝图。我可以戴上我的海盗帽吗？哦！好了，乔治船长！

lines.en: The map is a bit difficult. Daddy, can you help? Of course, Peppa. I'm very good with maps. Uh, it is a bit difficult.
lines.zh: 这张地图有点难。爸爸，你能帮忙吗？当然可以，佩奇。我特别擅长看地图。呃，它确实有点难。

lines.en: Daddy Pig, you're holding the map upside down! Yes, I thought as much.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸，你把地图拿反了！是的，我也觉得是。

lines.en: It's easy. See, the red cross shows where the treasure is. But where in the garden are those two apple trees? Hmm, I don't know. Would you like a clue? Yes, please.
lines.zh: 这很简单。看，红色的叉就是宝藏的位置。可是花园里的那两棵苹果树在哪儿呢？嗯，我不知道。你们想要个提示吗？想！

lines.en: The first clue is in a bottle. But where is the bottle? I can see it.
lines.zh: 第一条线索在一个瓶子里。可瓶子在哪儿呢？我看见它了。

lines.en: Peppa has found the first clue: a message in a bottle. Look, everyone, here's the bottle. Well done, Peppa! Let's see what the message says.
lines.zh: 佩奇找到了第一条线索：一个漂流瓶里的信。大家看，瓶子在这儿。干得好，佩奇！我们看看信上写了什么。

lines.en: Oh, it's a message from a pirate. Mummy, can you read the pirate's message? Hmm, this pirate has very bad handwriting.
lines.zh: 哦，是海盗写的一封信。妈妈，你能读一下海盗的信吗？嗯，这个海盗的字写得真差。

lines.en: The pirate's handwriting is excellent! No, I can't make it out at all.
lines.zh: 海盗的字写得棒极了！不对，我根本看不出来。

lines.en: The pirate has clearly written: follow the arrows.
lines.zh: 海盗写得清清楚楚：跟着箭头走。

lines.en: George has found the second clue: sticks in the shape of an arrow. Look, they point this way.
lines.zh: 乔治找到了第二条线索：摆成箭头形状的树枝。看，它们指向这边。

lines.en: Peppa and George are following the arrows. Look, George, a key!
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治跟着箭头走。乔治你看，一把钥匙！

lines.en: Peppa has found the next clue: a key! Well done, Peppa! Now you just have to find the treasure chest that it unlocks.
lines.zh: 佩奇找到了下一条线索：一把钥匙！干得好，佩奇！现在你们只要找到它能打开的宝箱就行了。

lines.en: But there aren't any more clues. Maybe you should take another look at the map.
lines.zh: 可是没有别的线索了。也许你们该再看看那张地图。

lines.en: Look, Peppa, the map has two apple trees on it. Here's an apple tree, and here's an apple tree. So the treasure must be here!
lines.zh: 佩奇你看，地图上画着两棵苹果树。这儿有一棵苹果树，这儿也有一棵苹果树。所以宝藏肯定就在这儿！

lines.en: Let's take a look.
lines.zh: 我们挖开看看吧。

lines.en: Oh, dear. There doesn't seem to be anything here. Hang on, there is something here!
lines.zh: 哦，天哪。这儿好像什么都没有。等等，这儿有东西！

lines.en: Wow! Treasure! Well done! Well done!
lines.zh: 哇！宝藏！干得好！干得好！

lines.en: I've got the key to open it. Wow! I can't believe it! Gold coins! They must be worth a fortune!
lines.zh: 我有打开它的钥匙。哇！我简直不敢相信！金币！它们一定值一大笔钱！

lines.en: It's better than that. They're not gold coins, they are chocolate coins. And there's a chocolate coin for everybody.
lines.zh: 比那更好。它们不是金币，是巧克力币。而且每个人都有一个巧克力币。

lines.en: Peppa and George love chocolate coins.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治喜欢巧克力币。

lines.en: Everyone loves chocolate coins. Granny, Grandpa, this is the best treasure hunt ever!
lines.zh: 大家都喜欢巧克力币。奶奶，爷爷，这是最棒的一次寻宝游戏！
